logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Two-panel analytical illustration for the WO-02 assurance handover. Left panel: a bar chart of measured energy per candidate on a clearly stated 0-55 kWh linear axis with gridlines every 10 kWh and correct proportional bar heights — P4 9 kWh (accent color, marked recommended), P3 20, P2 33, P1 50 — with axis label "kWh per common HVAC duty test" and a note that the trusted table is authoritative. Right panel: a vertical workflow diagram of the round-2 review: A brief (prose correct, protocol-assigned ballot, defective left panel) then B verification memo (independent recomputation confirming P4, A figure flagged) then C ballot P4 and handover. Beneath the workflow, a defect-log box listing the three logged rendering faults, and an open-questions box listing the carried-forward questions (P4-P3 variance, P4 defect severity, unverified cost/delivery/maintenance). Flat, readable, sans-serif, no decorative imagery; every element serves the client ranking and assurance story.
